description:
HushMessenger for Messenger 586.0.0.55.92, 6 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer. 88 patches. Calls have their own section now, with switches to record a call or ask before one starts. Hold a message and its actions come up in your own order, and old chats can be searched through the messages your phone kept. Light mode can take a color, and the People tab can come back on accounts that lost it. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New

- `Clone install under another package name` has a new option, `Facebook package to open`. Put a Facebook clone's ID there (like `com.facebook.katana.morphe`) and a Messenger clone opens profiles, shared stories and other Facebook links in that clone, and checks for it instead of the regular app when it asks whether Facebook is installed. Sign-in and account sharing still use the regular Facebook app. (Hushfacebook #348)
- `Search saved messages` is a new switch under Conversations, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It adds a button to a chat's search results that looks through the messages this phone has saved for that chat, and tapping a result opens the chat there. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted. It can only find what the phone has loaded, so the screen says how far back it got, and scrolling up in the chat loads more. It reads Messenger's data without changing it, and it starts off. Refs #92.
- `Record calls` is a new switch under Calls. During a call it puts a Record button over Messenger, and the call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. It needs Android 10 or newer. It's experimental for now and starts off. Refs #105.
- `Hide call buttons` is a new switch under Calls. It takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so a tap meant for something else can't start an awkward call. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Refs #121.
- `Save button for voice messages` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Hold a voice message, tap More, and Save voice message is at the top, for keeping just that one. It lands in the same folder as `Save voice messages you play`, which can stay off. Refs #123.
- The message log got easier to get around in. There's a search box that looks through words and names and doesn't care about accents, and `Group by chat` lists your chats so you can open one. `Save as text` and `Save as CSV` write what's showing to a file you pick, and `Save messages before they're removed` adds each message to a text file in Download/Messenger just before the log drops it, one file a month. Saved files aren't encrypted, so that switch starts off, and it needs Android 10 or newer. Refs #127.
- `Row in the Menu tab` is a new switch under `Keep a message log`. It puts a Message log row in Messenger's Menu tab, right under the HushMessenger one, and tapping it opens the log without going through settings first. It starts off, and it shows on patches that have `Open settings from menu`. Refs #133.
- `Preview chats on long press` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and you get a peek at the conversation with the chat's menu under it, instead of the menu alone. It's Messenger's own preview, which Meta only gives some accounts, so it looks and works like Messenger's. Refs #134.
- `Show People tab` is a new switch under Navigation. On accounts where Messenger took the People tab out of the bottom bar, it puts it back right after Chats. If `Hide People tab` is on too, the tab stays hidden. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- `Customize message actions` is a new switch under Conversations. Hold a message and its actions come up in the order you set, without the ones you hid. Messages you sent and messages you got get separate lists in settings, and each fills in the first time you hold one of those messages. The first actions go in the row of buttons and the rest go under More, which keeps your order instead of moving Messenger's picks to the top. `Reset to Messenger's order` puts a list back. It starts off. Refs #144.
- The message log does more now. `Direct` and `Groups` at the top split one-to-one chats from group chats, and a chat that shows up with no name can get one you pick, which search finds too. Photos people send you get their own entry, and when Messenger's notification carries a preview picture the log keeps that too, encrypted like the words. You also pick how long messages stay (30 days, 90 days, a year or until you clear the log), and the log holds up to 5,000 now instead of 500. `Button at the top of Chats` puts a clock next to the new message button that opens the log. Refs #131.
- `Keep the search bar` is a new switch under Inbox. Some accounts lost the search bar above their chats when Messenger moved search behind an icon, and this brings the bar back and drops the icon. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Accounts that never got the icon see no change. It's still experimental, so it starts off. Refs #128.
- `Ask before a call` is a new switch under Calls. Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat asks "Start a voice call?" or "Start a video call?" first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Refs #130.
- `Jump to the first message or a date` is a new switch under Conversations. Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat and pick the first message or a day. Messenger only loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count at the bottom of the screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. Refs #130.
- Calls have their own section in settings and in Morphe's patch list now, so `Quiet incoming calls` sits there next to the other call switches instead of under Conversations. Refs #130.
- Light mode can have a color now. `Unlock app themes` is a new switch under Theme that lets you pick any theme in Messenger's own Theme setting without a subscription, and the check moves to the theme you tap right away instead of after you leave the page. Material You also got a `Light mode accent` switch, which gives Messenger's blues in light mode your accent while grays and white stay put. Pick that accent from the new row of colors in Appearance, or keep your wallpaper's. Refs #132.
- `Report a problem` now also says whether Messenger's notifications can pop up on your phone. It fills in Android's notification switch for Messenger, your chat bubbles choice, whether Messenger may draw over other apps and show calls full screen, and which notification channels sit below the level that pops up. Channels are listed by Messenger's own id for them, so no chat names end up in the report. Refs #126.
- `Your own home header` is a new switch under Theme. Type a few words or pick a picture and it shows at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Words take the wordmark's own colors, gradient and dark mode white included, and stand as tall as its letters in the same spot. A picture keeps its colors, sits at that height too and wins when both are set. With neither, the wordmark stays. Refs #129.
- Quick setups has an `iPhone look` choice now. One tap puts a Chats title over your chat list in place of the wordmark and keeps the search bar under it, the way Messenger looks on an iPhone. It turns on `Your own home header` and `Keep the search bar`, and it only fills in the header's words when you haven't picked any (or a picture). Undo takes it all back. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- The HushMessenger settings icon in the app drawer has a blue gear of its own now, and its name comes from the app's resources the way Messenger's does. Some launchers (one on a realme phone) showed it as a second Messenger icon with Messenger's name. The text menu's Bold and Italic rows get the same treatment, and so do Restart Messenger and a clone's app name, and the settings name follows your language where the settings page does. Refs #141, #125.
- `Hide pictures on the Blocked list` is a new switch under Privacy. The list of people you've blocked, in Privacy and safety, keeps their names and Unblock but drops their profile pictures, the same way Messenger already shows someone it can't look up. It starts off. (Hushfacebook #361)
- `Allow landscape` is a new switch under Conversations. Messenger turns sideways with your phone when auto-rotate is on, so you get a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos, and a photo or video you close doesn't snap the screen back upright. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. It starts off while it's experimental. Refs #140.
- `Hide chosen chats` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and tap Hide from chat list, and that chat stays off your list even when new messages come in. Search still finds it. The chats you've hidden are listed under the switch with an Unhide button each, and they're kept per account on this phone. Hiding doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. This one's experimental too, and it starts off. Refs #139.
- `Notify for restricted chats` is a new switch under Privacy. Restricting someone in Messenger also stops their messages from notifying you. With this on they notify you like any other chat, and a chat you've muted still stays quiet. End-to-end encrypted chats aren't covered, and most one-to-one chats are encrypted now. The chat stays in your restricted list, and they still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. It's experimental and it starts off. Refs #143.

### Changed and fixed

- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 586.0.0.55.92. 585.0.0.53.94 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Arm64 phones can use builds 347215257, 347215330, 347215343, 347215344 or 347215348, and 347215257 and 347215343 are the nodpi ones with icons for every screen. Each was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. On any other 586 build the patch stops before it changes anything, so pick one of those five. Refs #137, #145.
- Messenger 586's 32-bit build (armeabi-v7a, 347215341) is supported too, so 32-bit phones can patch 586. It was checked patch by patch the same way, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. Refs #106.
- The patches are built with Morphe's patcher 2.2.0 now, so they need Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer, or Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer. Refs #137, #138.
- `Hide Meta AI` also hides Meta AI's offer to summarize the messages you haven't read. That's the "Summarize N unread messages" pill over a chat and the Summarize link on the unread divider. They're never built, so they don't leave a gap. Refs #142.
- Chat heads show up for messages that arrive while Messenger is still running in the background, once you allow it unrestricted battery use. On Optimized battery Android blocks the chat head in that case, so one only appeared if Messenger had been closed. `Allow chat bubbles` now has an `Allow unrestricted battery use` button under its modes that asks Android for it, and its help text says why.
- Coming back to HushMessenger's settings from an Android screen, like `Android bubble settings`, keeps your place in the list. If you'd searched first, the list used to jump back up to the search box.
- Someone who calls you while HushMessenger's settings sit open behind Messenger now shows up under `Only chosen chats` when you go back to settings. The list used to stay as it was until you left settings and opened them again.
- `Pin more chats` works now. A fourth pin used to end in Messenger's "Can't pin chat", because the limit lives on Meta's servers and nothing on the phone can talk them out of it. Pins past the limit now stay on your phone instead. They go to the top with the pin mark and stay there after a restart, and you unpin them the usual way. They won't show on your other devices. Chats that don't offer Pin at all get it back the same way. Turn the switch off or pause HushMessenger and those pins step aside until you turn it back on. Refs #56, #60, #47.
- `Record calls` no longer tries to post its notification on Android 13 and newer when Messenger isn't allowed to show notifications. The call still records and saves, and the button over the call says it's recording.
- **Restore screens on re-signed builds** changes nothing when it can't place its push service fix in a Messenger build. It used to have the signature answer in place already by the time it gave up.
- If a part of HushMessenger that starts with Messenger can't load, Messenger opens anyway and only that part stays off. Before, a class that failed to load at that moment could close Messenger before safe mode had a chance to run.
- New messages pop up at the top of the screen again on a phone where they'd stopped. While chat heads were on, Messenger lowered its Chats notification channel for good, and only Meta's server flags ever raised it back, so the pop-ups stayed gone even with chat heads turned off. **Keep chat pop-ups** is a new patch with no switch that stops the lowering and raises the channel at the next start. It leaves the channel alone if you changed it yourself in Android's settings, and picking `Chat heads` under `Allow chat bubbles` keeps Messenger's own behavior. Refs #126.
- `Mark as read button` now shows up in chats whose top bar was full with no chat details button to replace, like a chat with a Label button, an Add friend button, a Meta AI button or a group's home button next to the call buttons. It takes the place of a button that isn't for calls there, so the call buttons still stay put. Refs #122.
- Android Auto's launcher opens Messenger again instead of showing the HushMessenger settings entry in its place. The drawer entry now sorts after Messenger's own, so anything that launches Messenger by package name lands in Messenger, like Android Auto or the Facebook app's Messenger button. A Manager's Open button does the same. The `Android Auto messages` text now says Unknown sources is only enough on a desktop head unit, since a real car can still leave Messenger out, and that playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with `Hide read receipts` on. Refs #75.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video from Google Photos no longer crashes Messenger when the folder it copies your pick into won't take the file. The copy moves to another of Messenger's own folders and the send carries on, and **Report a problem** says which folder refused and why. Refs #124.
- `Bold and italic text` now puts Bold and Italic straight into the chat box's text menu, by name, with nothing to tick first on a Samsung phone. On some Samsung phones those two rows showed up as Messenger and Messenger, and they brought Dictionary, Translate and other apps' rows into the chat box along with them. Those rows are gone from the chat box again. Refs #125.
- `Check for updates` can't close Messenger anymore when the check breaks in a way it didn't plan for. It says it couldn't check, the same as when you're offline, and **Report a problem** picks up what went wrong.
- Saving your choices to a file now says "Couldn't save your choices to the file" when that fails. It used to show the clipboard's message. A restore that only gets some of them back reads like "Restored 3 of 5 choices." now.
- A switch that stopped with an error doesn't keep saying so after you repatch. That error came from the older patch, so the line under the switch and `Copy setup` now leave it out until the new one hits a problem of its own. A part that keeps failing also logs once a minute instead of every time the screen redraws.
- In a right-to-left language the arrows on the settings sections point the right way. A closed section's arrow pointed up and an open one's pointed down.
- TalkBack reads a settings section's name and count first. It used to say "Collapsed, Button" before the name.
- Buttons in the Hush settings with a short label like "OK" are at least 48 dp wide now, so they're as easy to hit as the taller ones.
- The Hush settings page has a new layout, the one HushGram uses, drawn in Messenger's colors. It opens on the HushMessenger logo and name, and the name moves up into the top bar once you scroll past it. Right under the name is the search box, with `Show all settings as a list` below it if you'd rather see every switch at once. Sections are cards now, each row with its own icon. Sheets got bigger titles and buttons that are easier to tell apart, and the restart bar sits at the bottom of the screen. Dark mode is true black and light mode follows the same layout. Switches are squared off, with the thumb inside the track. The HushMessenger name and the other titles drift through Messenger's blues, sky to royal, and the pink and orange are gone.
- A switch that can't work on your phone says why on a line of its own now, at full strength. The reason used to be dimmed along with the switch, and it was hard to read. `Log out` does the same with the line that says where to log out instead.
- Buttons that remove something are red, like `Clear log` and `Remove the picture`, or the one that removes an auto reply or its picture, and they look grayed out while they can't be used. Text boxes have a thicker outline that turns red while what's in one needs fixing, and an empty auto reply now says "Write a reply here, or remove this one before saving."
- The `Shared install` help is an amber warning now, since uninstalling Messenger from there removes its data too. The note that auto reply is off sits in a box of its own instead of one that looked like a text field.
- Cards in settings, the sheets, the message log and the restart screen all use the same corners and padding.
- A search left typed on the Controls tab doesn't rename the App tab's top bar anymore.
- In the message log, a chat's name is in the link color when tapping it opens that chat.
- `Search saved messages` shows each result as its own card with room between them, and a long message ends in "…". Tapping Search with nothing typed says to type a word first instead of doing nothing.
- Picking an accent color, `Use copied theme`, `Back to wallpaper colors` and `Remove the picture` under `Your own home header` can all be undone with Undo at the top of settings. The color dots and the Record button over a call show your tap now.
- Settings stay put under your finger. Undo showing up at the top, or going away 10 seconds later, used to push every row down and back up, and the note above the color dots did the same when an accent pick changed its length. The page moves with them now, so the dot or button you just tapped stays where it was.
- The bar at the bottom of a chat while `Jump to the first message or a date` scrolls back has a line along its top, and TalkBack names it when it shows up. A tap beside Cancel no longer lands on the chat box under it.
- When an update is out, `View release` is the main button under `Check for updates`, and a check that fails says so in red.
- An auto reply picture with see-through parts, like a logo saved as a PNG, goes out on white. Those parts used to turn black.

### Checks

- The How to update step in the release notes lists the version codes the release was checked against, instead of saying any build on APKMirror works. v0.28.0's notes said that, and then APKMirror posted 17 more 585 builds that v0.28.0 doesn't take, newer `nodpi` ones included. Refs #138, #145.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` no longer taps anything on Messenger's chat restore prompt, as its own notes always said. When the prompt turns up in front of a later screen, the walk opens the chat link to get past it and then opens that screen again, the way it already did for the chat list. `-Thread` has to be a chat's numeric user id now, and a walk given `-Serial` without `-OutDir` keeps its steps and receipt in a folder for that phone, so walks on two phones at once don't clear each other's.
- `scripts/CompatReport.java --save` records a new Messenger build now instead of failing because the build isn't recorded yet. Without `--save` that build still fails. A damaged APK or a broken line in a record gets one line naming the file and exit code 2, not a Java stack trace.

patches.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Allow landscape
patches.description: Lets Messenger turn sideways with your phone, for a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos. It follows your phone's auto-rotate setting. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Restart Messenger after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Android Auto messages
patches.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat's top bar asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Auto reply
patches.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Bigger chat preview
patches.description: Gives the chat more room in the preview you get when you press and hold a chat, and lets you scroll back through it there. The menu under it keeps a set height and scrolls when it has more items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Bold and italic text
patches.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Clone install under another package name
patches.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The name shown under the copy's home screen icon. Up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or number.

Which Facebook app Messenger opens profiles and other links in. Leave com.facebook.katana for the regular app, or use a Facebook clone's ID, like com.facebook.katana.morphe. Sign-in and account sharing keep using the regular app.
The copy's unique app ID, like com.facebook.orca.hush. Use words joined by dots, each starting with a letter. It can't match Messenger or another Meta app.

patches.name: Custom launcher icon
patches.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: White on black draws Messenger's logo in white on a black icon. Black on white draws it in black on a white one.

patches.name: Custom new-message sound
patches.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: Your .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file, 1 MB or smaller. Leave it empty to keep Messenger's own sound.

patches.name: Customize message actions
patches.description: Lets you choose the order of the actions you get by holding a message, and hide the ones you don't use, separately for messages you sent and messages you got. The first ones show in the row under the message and the rest under More. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Floating tab bar
patches.description: Switches the tab bar at the bottom to the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats instead of below them. Messenger may keep its usual bar on some screens. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Mark as read
patches.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, AI in search and in @ suggestions, and the offer to summarize a chat's unread messages. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide People You May Know
patches.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide People tab
patches.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Reels badge
patches.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, your phone's share menu no longer offers Messenger's Your story, so it goes straight to Chats. The Send to list drops Your story too, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide call buttons
patches.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide chat menu items
patches.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list. Press and hold any chat once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide chat promotions
patches.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide chosen chats
patches.description: Adds Hide from chat list to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. A hidden chat stays off your chat list when new messages come in, and search still finds it. Hiding stays on this phone, and you can unhide chats in HushMessenger settings. It doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide event prompts
patches.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide friend request cards
patches.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide growth prompts
patches.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide joined community chats
patches.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide stories and notes
patches.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide tab badges
patches.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide the Instants button
patches.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide the tab bar while scrolling
patches.description: Slides the tab bar at the bottom out of the way as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hold stories at the end
patches.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep a message log
patches.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too. Log chats that don't notify, under it, adds muted and restricted chats without notifying you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep the search bar
patches.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. In end-to-end encrypted chats the message stays in its notification instead, since the chat itself can't keep it. Group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Mark as read button
patches.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. When the bar is full it takes the place of the chat details button (tapping the chat's name opens the same page), or of another button that isn't for calls when a chat doesn't have one, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Light mode keeps its colors unless you turn on Light mode accent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Notify for restricted chats
patches.description: Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Open settings from menu
patches.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches.name: Open web links externally
patches.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Open your gallery app
patches.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Pin more chats
patches.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Preview chats on long press
patches.description: Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Record calls
patches.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Save any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Save button for voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Save voice messages you play
patches.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Search saved messages
patches.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Send photos at original quality
patches.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Show People tab
patches.description: Puts the People tab back in the bar at the bottom, right after Chats, on accounts where Messenger took it away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Slide chats in and out
patches.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Spoof package version
patches.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: A whole number up to 2147483647, no lower than the Messenger you're patching. Pick one higher than Messenger's version in the Play Store, or it will keep offering updates. The default is the highest Android allows.

patches.name: Square profile pictures
patches.description: Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop live connection logging
patches.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop nearby scans
patches.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Unlock app themes
patches.description: Lets you pick any theme in Messenger's Theme setting without a subscription, so light mode can get a color too. Messenger still decides which themes it offers your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use system emoji
patches.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use your own font
patches.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Your own home header
patches.description: Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

release_notes:
HushMessenger for Messenger 586.0.0.55.92, 6 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer. 88 patches. Calls have their own section now, with switches to record a call or ask before one starts. Hold a message and its actions come up in your own order, and old chats can be searched through the messages your phone kept. Light mode can take a color, and the People tab can come back on accounts that lost it. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Clone install under another package name` has a new option, `Facebook package to open`. Put a Facebook clone's ID there (like `com.facebook.katana.morphe`) and a Messenger clone opens profiles, shared stories and other Facebook links in that clone, and checks for it instead of the regular app when it asks whether Facebook is installed. Sign-in and account sharing still use the regular Facebook app. (Hushfacebook #348)
- `Search saved messages` is a new switch under Conversations, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It adds a button to a chat's search results that looks through the messages this phone has saved for that chat, and tapping a result opens the chat there. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted. It can only find what the phone has loaded, so the screen says how far back it got, and scrolling up in the chat loads more. It reads Messenger's data without changing it, and it starts off. Refs #92.
- `Record calls` is a new switch under Calls. During a call it puts a Record button over Messenger, and the call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. It needs Android 10 or newer. It's experimental for now and starts off. Refs #105.
- `Hide call buttons` is a new switch under Calls. It takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so a tap meant for something else can't start an awkward call. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Refs #121.
- `Save button for voice messages` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Hold a voice message, tap More, and Save voice message is at the top, for keeping just that one. It lands in the same folder as `Save voice messages you play`, which can stay off. Refs #123.
- The message log got easier to get around in. There's a search box that looks through words and names and doesn't care about accents, and `Group by chat` lists your chats so you can open one. `Save as text` and `Save as CSV` write what's showing to a file you pick, and `Save messages before they're removed` adds each message to a text file in Download/Messenger just before the log drops it, one file a month. Saved files aren't encrypted, so that switch starts off, and it needs Android 10 or newer. Refs #127.
- `Row in the Menu tab` is a new switch under `Keep a message log`. It puts a Message log row in Messenger's Menu tab, right under the HushMessenger one, and tapping it opens the log without going through settings first. It starts off, and it shows on patches that have `Open settings from menu`. Refs #133.
- `Preview chats on long press` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and you get a peek at the conversation with the chat's menu under it, instead of the menu alone. It's Messenger's own preview, which Meta only gives some accounts, so it looks and works like Messenger's. Refs #134.
- `Show People tab` is a new switch under Navigation. On accounts where Messenger took the People tab out of the bottom bar, it puts it back right after Chats. If `Hide People tab` is on too, the tab stays hidden. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- `Customize message actions` is a new switch under Conversations. Hold a message and its actions come up in the order you set, without the ones you hid. Messages you sent and messages you got get separate lists in settings, and each fills in the first time you hold one of those messages. The first actions go in the row of buttons and the rest go under More, which keeps your order instead of moving Messenger's picks to the top. `Reset to Messenger's order` puts a list back. It starts off. Refs #144.
- The message log does more now. `Direct` and `Groups` at the top split one-to-one chats from group chats, and a chat that shows up with no name can get one you pick, which search finds too. Photos people send you get their own entry, and when Messenger's notification carries a preview picture the log keeps that too, encrypted like the words. You also pick how long messages stay (30 days, 90 days, a year or until you clear the log), and the log holds up to 5,000 now instead of 500. `Button at the top of Chats` puts a clock next to the new message button that opens the log. Refs #131.
- `Keep the search bar` is a new switch under Inbox. Some accounts lost the search bar above their chats when Messenger moved search behind an icon, and this brings the bar back and drops the icon. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Accounts that never got the icon see no change. It's still experimental, so it starts off. Refs #128.
- `Ask before a call` is a new switch under Calls. Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat asks "Start a voice call?" or "Start a video call?" first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Refs #130.
- `Jump to the first message or a date` is a new switch under Conversations. Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat and pick the first message or a day. Messenger only loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count at the bottom of the screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. Refs #130.
- Calls have their own section in settings and in Morphe's patch list now, so `Quiet incoming calls` sits there next to the other call switches instead of under Conversations. Refs #130.
- Light mode can have a color now. `Unlock app themes` is a new switch under Theme that lets you pick any theme in Messenger's own Theme setting without a subscription, and the check moves to the theme you tap right away instead of after you leave the page. Material You also got a `Light mode accent` switch, which gives Messenger's blues in light mode your accent while grays and white stay put. Pick that accent from the new row of colors in Appearance, or keep your wallpaper's. Refs #132.
- `Report a problem` now also says whether Messenger's notifications can pop up on your phone. It fills in Android's notification switch for Messenger, your chat bubbles choice, whether Messenger may draw over other apps and show calls full screen, and which notification channels sit below the level that pops up. Channels are listed by Messenger's own id for them, so no chat names end up in the report. Refs #126.
- `Your own home header` is a new switch under Theme. Type a few words or pick a picture and it shows at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Words take the wordmark's own colors, gradient and dark mode white included, and stand as tall as its letters in the same spot. A picture keeps its colors, sits at that height too and wins when both are set. With neither, the wordmark stays. Refs #129.
- Quick setups has an `iPhone look` choice now. One tap puts a Chats title over your chat list in place of the wordmark and keeps the search bar under it, the way Messenger looks on an iPhone. It turns on `Your own home header` and `Keep the search bar`, and it only fills in the header's words when you haven't picked any (or a picture). Undo takes it all back. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- The HushMessenger settings icon in the app drawer has a blue gear of its own now, and its name comes from the app's resources the way Messenger's does. Some launchers (one on a realme phone) showed it as a second Messenger icon with Messenger's name. The text menu's Bold and Italic rows get the same treatment, and so do Restart Messenger and a clone's app name, and the settings name follows your language where the settings page does. Refs #141, #125.
- `Hide pictures on the Blocked list` is a new switch under Privacy. The list of people you've blocked, in Privacy and safety, keeps their names and Unblock but drops their profile pictures, the same way Messenger already shows someone it can't look up. It starts off. (Hushfacebook #361)
- `Allow landscape` is a new switch under Conversations. Messenger turns sideways with your phone when auto-rotate is on, so you get a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos, and a photo or video you close doesn't snap the screen back upright. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. It starts off while it's experimental. Refs #140.
- `Hide chosen chats` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and tap Hide from chat list, and that chat stays off your list even when new messages come in. Search still finds it. The chats you've hidden are listed under the switch with an Unhide button each, and they're kept per account on this phone. Hiding doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. This one's experimental too, and it starts off. Refs #139.
- `Notify for restricted chats` is a new switch under Privacy. Restricting someone in Messenger also stops their messages from notifying you. With this on they notify you like any other chat, and a chat you've muted still stays quiet. End-to-end encrypted chats aren't covered, and most one-to-one chats are encrypted now. The chat stays in your restricted list, and they still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. It's experimental and it starts off. Refs #143.

### Fixes and changes

- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 586.0.0.55.92. 585.0.0.53.94 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Arm64 phones can use builds 347215257, 347215330, 347215343, 347215344 or 347215348, and 347215257 and 347215343 are the nodpi ones with icons for every screen. Each was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. On any other 586 build the patch stops before it changes anything, so pick one of those five. Refs #137, #145.
- Messenger 586's 32-bit build (armeabi-v7a, 347215341) is supported too, so 32-bit phones can patch 586. It was checked patch by patch the same way, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. Refs #106.
- The patches are built with Morphe's patcher 2.2.0 now, so they need Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer, or Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer. Refs #137, #138.
- `Hide Meta AI` also hides Meta AI's offer to summarize the messages you haven't read. That's the "Summarize N unread messages" pill over a chat and the Summarize link on the unread divider. They're never built, so they don't leave a gap. Refs #142.
- Chat heads show up for messages that arrive while Messenger is still running in the background, once you allow it unrestricted battery use. On Optimized battery Android blocks the chat head in that case, so one only appeared if Messenger had been closed. `Allow chat bubbles` now has an `Allow unrestricted battery use` button under its modes that asks Android for it, and its help text says why.
- Coming back to HushMessenger's settings from an Android screen, like `Android bubble settings`, keeps your place in the list. If you'd searched first, the list used to jump back up to the search box.
- Someone who calls you while HushMessenger's settings sit open behind Messenger now shows up under `Only chosen chats` when you go back to settings. The list used to stay as it was until you left settings and opened them again.
- `Pin more chats` works now. A fourth pin used to end in Messenger's "Can't pin chat", because the limit lives on Meta's servers and nothing on the phone can talk them out of it. Pins past the limit now stay on your phone instead. They go to the top with the pin mark and stay there after a restart, and you unpin them the usual way. They won't show on your other devices. Chats that don't offer Pin at all get it back the same way. Turn the switch off or pause HushMessenger and those pins step aside until you turn it back on. Refs #56, #60, #47.
- `Record calls` no longer tries to post its notification on Android 13 and newer when Messenger isn't allowed to show notifications. The call still records and saves, and the button over the call says it's recording.
- **Restore screens on re-signed builds** changes nothing when it can't place its push service fix in a Messenger build. It used to have the signature answer in place already by the time it gave up.
- If a part of HushMessenger that starts with Messenger can't load, Messenger opens anyway and only that part stays off. Before, a class that failed to load at that moment could close Messenger before safe mode had a chance to run.
- New messages pop up at the top of the screen again on a phone where they'd stopped. While chat heads were on, Messenger lowered its Chats notification channel for good, and only Meta's server flags ever raised it back, so the pop-ups stayed gone even with chat heads turned off. **Keep chat pop-ups** is a new patch with no switch that stops the lowering and raises the channel at the next start. It leaves the channel alone if you changed it yourself in Android's settings, and picking `Chat heads` under `Allow chat bubbles` keeps Messenger's own behavior. Refs #126.
- `Mark as read button` now shows up in chats whose top bar was full with no chat details button to replace, like a chat with a Label button, an Add friend button, a Meta AI button or a group's home button next to the call buttons. It takes the place of a button that isn't for calls there, so the call buttons still stay put. Refs #122.
- Android Auto's launcher opens Messenger again instead of showing the HushMessenger settings entry in its place. The drawer entry now sorts after Messenger's own, so anything that launches Messenger by package name lands in Messenger, like Android Auto or the Facebook app's Messenger button. A Manager's Open button does the same. The `Android Auto messages` text now says Unknown sources is only enough on a desktop head unit, since a real car can still leave Messenger out, and that playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with `Hide read receipts` on. Refs #75.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video from Google Photos no longer crashes Messenger when the folder it copies your pick into won't take the file. The copy moves to another of Messenger's own folders and the send carries on, and **Report a problem** says which folder refused and why. Refs #124.
- `Bold and italic text` now puts Bold and Italic straight into the chat box's text menu, by name, with nothing to tick first on a Samsung phone. On some Samsung phones those two rows showed up as Messenger and Messenger, and they brought Dictionary, Translate and other apps' rows into the chat box along with them. Those rows are gone from the chat box again. Refs #125.
- `Check for updates` can't close Messenger anymore when the check breaks in a way it didn't plan for. It says it couldn't check, the same as when you're offline, and **Report a problem** picks up what went wrong.
- Saving your choices to a file now says "Couldn't save your choices to the file" when that fails. It used to show the clipboard's message. A restore that only gets some of them back reads like "Restored 3 of 5 choices." now.
- A switch that stopped with an error doesn't keep saying so after you repatch. That error came from the older patch, so the line under the switch and `Copy setup` now leave it out until the new one hits a problem of its own. A part that keeps failing also logs once a minute instead of every time the screen redraws.
- In a right-to-left language the arrows on the settings sections point the right way. A closed section's arrow pointed up and an open one's pointed down.
- TalkBack reads a settings section's name and count first. It used to say "Collapsed, Button" before the name.
- Buttons in the Hush settings with a short label like "OK" are at least 48 dp wide now, so they're as easy to hit as the taller ones.
- The Hush settings page has a new layout, the one HushGram uses, drawn in Messenger's colors. It opens on the HushMessenger logo and name, and the name moves up into the top bar once you scroll past it. Right under the name is the search box, with `Show all settings as a list` below it if you'd rather see every switch at once. Sections are cards now, each row with its own icon. Sheets got bigger titles and buttons that are easier to tell apart, and the restart bar sits at the bottom of the screen. Dark mode is true black and light mode follows the same layout. Switches are squared off, with the thumb inside the track. The HushMessenger name and the other titles drift through Messenger's blues, sky to royal, and the pink and orange are gone.
- A switch that can't work on your phone says why on a line of its own now, at full strength. The reason used to be dimmed along with the switch, and it was hard to read. `Log out` does the same with the line that says where to log out instead.
- Buttons that remove something are red, like `Clear log` and `Remove the picture`, or the one that removes an auto reply or its picture, and they look grayed out while they can't be used. Text boxes have a thicker outline that turns red while what's in one needs fixing, and an empty auto reply now says "Write a reply here, or remove this one before saving."
- The `Shared install` help is an amber warning now, since uninstalling Messenger from there removes its data too. The note that auto reply is off sits in a box of its own instead of one that looked like a text field.
- Cards in settings, the sheets, the message log and the restart screen all use the same corners and padding.
- A search left typed on the Controls tab doesn't rename the App tab's top bar anymore.
- In the message log, a chat's name is in the link color when tapping it opens that chat.
- `Search saved messages` shows each result as its own card with room between them, and a long message ends in "…". Tapping Search with nothing typed says to type a word first instead of doing nothing.
- Picking an accent color, `Use copied theme`, `Back to wallpaper colors` and `Remove the picture` under `Your own home header` can all be undone with Undo at the top of settings. The color dots and the Record button over a call show your tap now.
- Settings stay put under your finger. Undo showing up at the top, or going away 10 seconds later, used to push every row down and back up, and the note above the color dots did the same when an accent pick changed its length. The page moves with them now, so the dot or button you just tapped stays where it was.
- The bar at the bottom of a chat while `Jump to the first message or a date` scrolls back has a line along its top, and TalkBack names it when it shows up. A tap beside Cancel no longer lands on the chat box under it.
- When an update is out, `View release` is the main button under `Check for updates`, and a check that fails says so in red.
- An auto reply picture with see-through parts, like a logo saved as a PNG, goes out on white. Those parts used to turn black.

### Behind the scenes

- The How to update step in the release notes lists the version codes the release was checked against, instead of saying any build on APKMirror works. v0.28.0's notes said that, and then APKMirror posted 17 more 585 builds that v0.28.0 doesn't take, newer `nodpi` ones included. Refs #138, #145.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` no longer taps anything on Messenger's chat restore prompt, as its own notes always said. When the prompt turns up in front of a later screen, the walk opens the chat link to get past it and then opens that screen again, the way it already did for the chat list. `-Thread` has to be a chat's numeric user id now, and a walk given `-Serial` without `-OutDir` keeps its steps and receipt in a folder for that phone, so walks on two phones at once don't clear each other's.
- `scripts/CompatReport.java --save` records a new Messenger build now instead of failing because the build isn't recorded yet. Without `--save` that build still fails. A damaged APK or a broken line in a record gets one line naming the file and exit code 2, not a Java stack trace.

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 586.0.0.55.92 first. On [APKMirror's 586.0.0.55.92 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-586-0-0-55-92-release/), take a build whose version code is 347215257, 347215330, 347215341, 347215343, 347215344 or 347215348. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.4.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **88 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.29.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 6 Messenger 586.0.0.55.92 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 2 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.
